cover-purple.headline: Your fundraising,
cover-purple.subtitle: Referred by Sarah at Rooted. A focused overview of DonorDock for Bay Area Literacy Partners — what's in the platform, what it costs, and how to get started.

your-moment.title: Sarah said you'd
your-moment.subtitle: Bay Area Literacy Partners is the kind of nonprofit DonorDock was built for — lean team, growing donor base, big mission, and a clear need for the right operational tools. Here's what fit looks like.

items.heading: Sarah's already framed the platform
items.body: Through her Rooted work, she's walked you through what DonorDock does. This doc gives you the same picture in writing — so your board can review it on their own time.

items.heading: Lean team, big donor base
items.body: You're stewarding hundreds of monthly donors with a two-person team. The right platform makes that scalable without adding headcount.

items.heading: Ready to consolidate
items.body: You've outgrown your current setup but aren't ready for an enterprise CRM. DonorDock is sized for your team and your roadmap.

what_you_need.title: What you need from a platform
items: One donor record per supporter
Online giving that flows directly into your CRM
Email and text built in, with engagement tracked on the record
Automated thank-yous and stewardship cadence
A grant pipeline to track applications
A migration team that does the work for you
A partner that scales with you

platform-overview-quad.title: Everything you need,
platform-overview-quad.subtitle: Built from the ground up as one connected platform — no patchwork of acquired tools, no hidden modules. Every feature below is included in one plan.

quadrants.title: CRM & Donor Management
items: Individual, household, and organization contact types
Custom badges — tag by donor tier, program, affinity
Full giving history, pledges, and soft credits per contact
Activity tracking: emails, events, notes — all connected
Drag-and-drop reports with column-level filtering

quadrants.title: Donor Outreach & Engagement
items: Drag-and-drop email builder
One-to-many and one-to-one text messaging
Letters, mail merge, and annual giving statements
Automated donor journeys — new donor, lapsed, anniversary
Every email and text tracked on the contact profile

quadrants.title: Online Giving
items: Unlimited giving pages — embedded on your website
Campaign-specific pages tied to appeals and funds
Recurring gifts, Apple Pay, Google Pay, DAF giving
Automatic receipts and thank-you emails on gift
Campaign, appeal, and fund tracking

quadrants.title: Project Management & Action
items: Action Board — daily prioritized task list
Otto AI Smart Nudges — surfaces donor opportunities
Ask Board — major gifts, grants, and sponsor pipelines
Project Boards — event planning, gala, grant workflows
Automations: external comms, internal tasks, data updates

footnote.title: One plan. All features. Nothing locked behind upgrades.
footnote.body: Every feature above is included at $500/month billed annually. Unlimited contacts. No tiers.

pricing-card-purple.title: One plan. One price.
pricing-card-purple.subtitle: One flat annual subscription — no per-contact fees, no feature tiers, no contracts.

included.title: Everything included
items: Donor Management CRM (unlimited contacts)
Email marketing (10,000/month + rollover credits)
Text messaging (1,000/month + rollover credits)
Unlimited giving pages
Otto AI assistant and Smart Nudges
Automations, pipelines, and project management
White glove data migration (included)
90-day Premium Onboarding program
Dedicated Customer Success Manager (ongoing)
5 users included

sidebar.title: Partner referral discount
sidebar.body: As a Rooted referral, Bay Area Literacy Partners qualifies for:
items: Sarah's team continues your data work in parallel with migration
Direct handoff between Rooted and DonorDock Customer Success
No double-engagement billing — one partnership, two teams

guarantee.title: 90-day money-back guarantee
guarantee.body: If DonorDock isn't the right fit in the first 90 days, you get a full refund — no questions asked.

next-steps-numbered.title: Ready when
next-steps-numbered.subtitle: Sarah has the full context on what you need. This doc gives your board what it needs to greenlight. Here's the path forward.

steps.heading: Share this with your board
steps.body: Two-page summary up front, full platform overview in the middle, pricing at the end. Should answer most board questions without you having to walk them through.

steps.heading: Loop me in for any questions
steps.body: Sarah at Rooted can answer most product questions. For anything contract-specific, pricing-specific, or migration-specific, I'm a quick email away.

steps.heading: When you're ready, the partnership starts
steps.body: Rooted and DonorDock work as one team during your migration. Sarah's team handles your data cleanup; ours handles the import and onboarding. Same calendar, different deliverables.
